entries.zh: 魍魎、鬼怪精魅之属；被鬼附身者、行邪术者
entries.en: demons, goblins, evil spirits (wang-liang); demoniac, possessed person; sorcerer

entries.zh: 龜精（龟所成之精怪）；妖魔邪祟
entries.en: tortoise-spirit, turtle demon; demoniac, sorcerer

entries.zh: 仇怨、敌意；结怨、结祸
entries.en: enmity, hostility; grudge
entries.notes: 西语栏 Enemistad 明确；汉字与官话栏均空，闽南栏 gui-ôn/gui-sân/gui-hô 三组读音仅部分与右栏結怨、結禍诸条相合

entries.zh: 掂量、掂（以手估量轻重；掂掇＝料理摆正）；惦（惦记）
entries.en: to weigh in the hand, estimate; to settle, set right, adjust (Sp. endereçar/adereçar)
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:掂/惦]，义项对应依赖推断

entries.zh: 仇敌、仇人；仇讎（右栏对译「兌讎」，疑为「冤讎」）
entries.en: enemy, foe, adversary
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:敵/讎]，西语栏有涂黑涂改；敌对之义四栏互证，惟字与读音存疑

entries.zh: 冤家（仇家、对头）
entries.en: enemy, foe; one with whom one has a grudge or quarrel (oan-ke)
entries.notes: 汉字「兌家」据闽南对音 van-gue 判读为「冤家」之异写，右栏并注仇敵；闽南栏有划删记

entries.zh: 冤仇、仇怨；讎報（报讎、寻仇报复）
entries.en: enmity, hatred; revenge, to repay a grudge
entries.notes: 「兌仇」同前条判读为「冤仇」之异写；闽南栏有划删记

entries.zh: 对头、仇敌（右栏孤证：enemigo 对译「對創」，疑为「對頭」讹写，待考）
entries.en: enemy, adversary (right column only; doubtful)
entries.notes: 仅官话栏成条，余三栏皆空；汉字「對創」与对音 tǔy lày 未能定夺

entries.zh: 嫌怨、恼怒（enfadarse）；伤害（dañar）；结怨（右栏 enemistad）
entries.en: to get angry, take offense; to harm, injure; enmity (right column)
entries.notes: 西语栏「Y dōnar」读作 y dañar（伤害）；汉字「嫻」疑为「嫌」之讹（闽南 hiām 相合）；右栏另记 enemistad／結完

entries.zh: 厌恶、厌烦；恼怒生怨；结怨（右栏 enemistad）
entries.en: to loathe, be sick of; to become angry; enmity (right column)
entries.notes: 闽南栏有 ✗ 删记且 gām 与「厭」对应存疑；左栏恼怒与右栏仇怨语义略参差

entries.zh: 结祸、结怨招祸；仇怨（右栏成条：enemistad 对译「結禍」）
entries.en: enmity; to bring about feud or calamity (chieh-huo)
entries.notes: 仅官话栏成条可读，左三栏空缺，故降中置信

entries.zh: 厌弃、嫌弃（厌恶而弃绝）
entries.en: to loathe and reject, despise, cast off

entries.zh: 厌贱、鄙贱（厌恶而轻贱）
entries.en: to despise, hold in contempt

entries.zh: 触怒人、惹人恼（Enfadar）
entries.en: to annoy, provoke anger
entries.notes: 汉字栏「唌人」字有疑；闽南 sīm-lâng 与右栏 nguien-sīn 对音未合，义从西语栏定夺

entries.zh: 病、疾病；病
entries.en: sick, ill; illness, sickness
entries.notes: 官话栏对音 gēng/pēng 存疑；病义据西语栏 enfermo/enfermedad 与汉字「病」互证

entries.zh: 瘴、瘴气（传染性疫病、瘴疠）
entries.en: miasma, pestilential fever; contagious disease (chang)

entries.zh: 危、危险；危重之症
entries.en: danger, peril; dangerous illness (gui)

entries.zh: 疴、沉疴；久病
entries.en: chronic illness, long-lasting disease (o)

entries.zh: 癠、轻病小疾（或为「瘵」痨疫）
entries.en: slight illness, mild disease; (alt. reading) consumption, pestilence
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:癠/瘵]；西语栏 enfermedad ligera（轻病）与对音 chū 相合

entries.zh: 瘟疫样的疫病（汉字疑「瘍／殤」，右栏对音与前条「瘴」同作 chiàng）
entries.en: a plague-like pestilence, epidemic (Chinese character uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:瘍/殤]而右栏音同「瘴」、闽南栏 ya 又不合，语义无法定夺故降低

entries.zh: 染病、沾染疾病（受病传染）
entries.en: to catch or contract a disease, be infected; also to dye, stain
entries.notes: 闽南栏两处 T99 污损难辨并多处涂改；义据西语栏 se le pegó la enfermedad 与汉字「染」互证

entries.zh: 辛苦、劳苦；受苦（病痛之苦）
entries.en: hardship, toil, suffering; (Spanish head) sick and ill
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:辛/幸]；右栏对音 sīn cā 与闽南 sīn còu 参差，苦义据字与 trabajo 定

entries.zh: 坎坷、不顺利；病痛劳苦
entries.en: hardship, setbacks, rough going; illness and toil (kham-kho)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 仅闽南栏残存对音 chen chen yen ⊠ yen guî̃，无西语词头与汉字，无法定夺

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 仅闽南栏残存对音 to yeñ chē̃ ✕ hiēn ✗ njām（两处删记），无词头与汉字，无法定夺
